about.title: About me
about.p1: Front-end Developer with 5+ years of experience building, evolving and supporting web applications for the financial, healthcare and HR-tech sectors.
about.p2: I work with React, Vue.js, Angular and TypeScript on Micro Frontend architectures, Design Systems and component documentation. I also have backend experience — Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL and MongoDB — which lets me collaborate end to end.
about.p3: Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering from the University of Brasília. English: advanced (C1).
